title: Schedule C and self-employment tax — Kai Moreno
instructions: Kai Moreno, single, runs a consulting business as a sole proprietor. Compute the amounts for Kai's 2025 return. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: 2025 business data
exhibits.content:
- Gross receipts: **$150,000**.
- Office supplies: **$12,000**.
- Business meals with clients: **$6,000**.
- Tickets to sporting events for clients: **$2,000**.
- Home office: **250** square feet used regularly and exclusively; Kai uses the simplified method ($5 per square foot, up to 300 square feet).
- Business driving: **10,000** miles; Kai uses the standard mileage rate of **70 cents** per mile.
- Health insurance premiums for Kai (no employer plan available): **$6,000**.

rows.label: Schedule C net profit
rows.explanation: 150,000 − 12,000 supplies − 3,000 meals (50%) − 0 entertainment − 1,250 home office − 7,000 mileage = **126,750**.
